text: On Halloween night in Warren Valley, Ohio, four stories cross paths around Sam, [a small trick-or-treater in orange footie pajamas and a burlap sack|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] who appears whenever someone [breaks a Halloween tradition|rules|break the rule and pay]. A woman blows out her jack-o'-lantern before midnight, a school principal [laces candy with acid|threat|people who kill], teenagers tell the legend of [eight children drowned in a flooded quarry|wrong|harm done to children], and a young woman dressed as Little Red Riding Hood heads for a bonfire in the woods.
